reading: Although AI is seen as a major factor behind graduate job cuts, companies are also establishing graduate positions specifically focused on the technology.
Recent graduate Lotte Underwood works in public relations but spends more time using AI than carrying out conventional public relations work.
Her remit includes managing AI agents, checking their results and passing material to colleagues who deal directly with clients and the media.
The dedicated AI team has built around 30 agents for activities ranging from industry research and interview preparation to helping clients produce clearer briefs.
At engineering software company Stride, graduate Dillan Patel was assigned to develop a chatbot designed to capture the knowledge of a senior employee transitioning into retirement.
His subsequent role includes identifying manual or repetitive work that AI could perform across the company.
Maxwell envisages graduates challenging an organisation to consider AI holistically, examining both potential applications and opportunities for business growth.
If AI makes graduate jobs more integral to an organisation, Maxwell argues, employers can build a more loyal and engaged workforce whose members contribute meaningfully earlier.

An analysis of 2.4 million US entry-level jobs found that the roles most influenced by AI were seven times more likely to require traditionally senior abilities, including motivational leadership and strategic decision making.
PwC found that entry-level roles with higher expectations had grown by 35% since 2019, whereas other entry-level roles had declined by 10%.
Clinton says greater opportunities to implement ideas have brought substantially more responsibility.
Clinton argues that advancement is becoming less dependent on accumulated knowledge and more dependent on critical thinking and an understanding of processes.
Underwood would like to gain traditional public relations experience beyond her current responsibilities, but remains confident about her future in the agency's growing AI team.
Pratt describes a programme in which graduates move through four areas at six-month intervals, learning alongside senior relationship managers.
Those graduates learn about financial products, prepare credit papers for lenders and develop customer relationships before progressing to managing entire transactions.
Claire Reed cautions that graduate roles dominated by AI will not necessarily support long-term career progression.
Reed nevertheless regards a baseline of AI literacy as a requirement for every graduate job.
Only when AI expertise is coupled with an understanding of what clients actually want can it support a graduate's career, one contributor argues.

vocabulary.definition: The range of responsibilities and activities assigned to a particular role.
Established specifically for a particular purpose, rather than handling it alongside unrelated work.
Documents or instructions setting out what a client wants a piece of work to achieve.
Moving from employment towards retirement, with emphasis on the process rather than a single departure date.
By considering how different parts of an organisation connect and affect the whole.
Closely involved in an organisation's central activities and important to how it functions.
The ability to encourage people to commit effort and work towards shared goals.
Choosing actions with an organisation's broader priorities and longer-term direction in mind.
Carefully examining information, assumptions and reasoning before reaching a judgement.
Development towards greater responsibility or more advanced positions over a working life.
A minimum starting standard expected of people in a particular situation.
Combined with another quality or resource so that the two operate together.

entries.ja: 特定の職務に割り当てられた責任や業務の範囲。
entries.ko: 특정 직무에 부여된 책임과 업무의 범위.
entries.zh-Hans: 某一特定岗位被赋予的职责和工作范围。
entries.es: El conjunto de responsabilidades y actividades asignadas a un puesto concreto.
entries.pt-BR: O conjunto de responsabilidades e atividades atribuídas a uma determinada função.
entries.fr: L’ensemble des responsabilités et des activités confiées à un poste donné.
entries.de: Der Umfang der Verantwortlichkeiten und Tätigkeiten, die einer bestimmten Stelle zugewiesen sind.

entries.ja: 無関係な業務と並行して扱うのではなく、特定の目的のために設けられた。
entries.ko: 관련 없는 업무와 병행하여 처리하는 것이 아니라, 특정 목적을 위해 별도로 마련된.
entries.zh-Hans: 专门为某一特定目的而设立的，而不是在处理其他无关工作的同时兼顾这一目的的。
entries.es: Creado específicamente para un propósito concreto, en vez de atenderlo junto con tareas no relacionadas.
entries.pt-BR: Criado especificamente para uma determinada finalidade, em vez de cuidar dela junto com trabalhos sem relação com ela.
entries.fr: Créé expressément pour un objectif précis, plutôt que pour s’en occuper en parallèle de tâches sans rapport.
entries.de: Eigens für einen bestimmten Zweck eingerichtet, statt sich diesem neben anderen, nicht damit zusammenhängenden Aufgaben zu widmen.

entries.ja: ある仕事で顧客が何を達成してほしいと考えているかを示す文書や指示。
entries.ko: 고객이 의뢰한 업무를 통해 무엇을 달성하기 원하는지 명시한 문서나 지침.
entries.zh-Hans: 说明客户希望某项工作达成什么目标的文件或指示。
entries.es: Documentos o instrucciones que detallan lo que un cliente quiere que se consiga con un trabajo.
entries.pt-BR: Documentos ou instruções que especificam o que um cliente deseja que um trabalho alcance.
entries.fr: Des documents ou des consignes précisant ce qu’un client souhaite obtenir d’un travail.
entries.de: Dokumente oder Anweisungen, die darlegen, was ein Kunde mit einer Arbeit erreichen möchte.

entries.ja: 仕事をしている状態から退職後の生活へ移っていくことで、ある一日の退職日ではなく、その移行の過程に重点を置いた表現。
entries.ko: 직장 생활에서 은퇴로 옮겨 가는 것으로, 특정한 퇴직일보다 그 전환 과정에 초점을 둔 표현.
entries.zh-Hans: 从在职状态逐步走向退休，强调的是这一转变过程，而不是某一个离职日期。
entries.es: Pasar del empleo a la jubilación, poniendo el énfasis en el proceso y no en una única fecha de salida.
entries.pt-BR: Passar do trabalho para a aposentadoria, com ênfase no processo, e não em uma única data de saída.
entries.fr: Passer de la vie professionnelle à la retraite, en mettant l’accent sur le processus plutôt que sur une date de départ unique.
entries.de: Vom Erwerbsleben in den Ruhestand übergehen, wobei der Übergangsprozess im Mittelpunkt steht und nicht ein einzelnes Datum des Ausscheidens.

entries.ja: 組織のさまざまな部分がどのようにつながり、組織全体にどう影響するかを考慮して。
entries.ko: 조직의 여러 부분이 어떻게 연결되고 조직 전체에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 고려하여.
entries.zh-Hans: 通过考虑组织的不同部分如何相互联系，以及如何影响整体。
entries.es: Considerando cómo se conectan las distintas partes de una organización y cómo afectan al conjunto.
entries.pt-BR: Considerando como as diferentes partes de uma organização se conectam e afetam o todo.
entries.fr: En tenant compte de la manière dont les différentes parties d’une organisation sont liées et influencent l’ensemble.
entries.de: Unter Berücksichtigung dessen, wie die verschiedenen Teile einer Organisation miteinander verbunden sind und das Ganze beeinflussen.

entries.ja: 組織の中心的な活動に深く関わり、その運営にとって重要である。
entries.ko: 조직의 핵심 활동에 밀접하게 관여하며 조직이 운영되는 데 중요한.
entries.zh-Hans: 深度融入组织的核心活动，并对组织的运作十分重要的。
entries.es: Estrechamente vinculado a las actividades centrales de una organización e importante para su funcionamiento.
entries.pt-BR: Estreitamente envolvido nas atividades centrais de uma organização e importante para seu funcionamento.
entries.fr: Étroitement associé aux activités centrales d’une organisation et important pour son fonctionnement.
entries.de: Eng in die zentralen Tätigkeiten einer Organisation eingebunden und für ihre Funktionsweise wichtig.

entries.ja: 人々が力を注ぎ、共通の目標に向かって取り組むよう促す能力。
entries.ko: 사람들이 노력을 기울이고 공동의 목표를 향해 일하도록 격려하는 능력.
entries.zh-Hans: 鼓励人们投入精力并为共同目标努力的能力。
entries.es: La capacidad de animar a las personas a esforzarse y trabajar para alcanzar objetivos comunes.
entries.pt-BR: A capacidade de incentivar as pessoas a se empenharem e trabalharem em direção a objetivos comuns.
entries.fr: La capacité à encourager les personnes à s’investir et à travailler pour atteindre des objectifs communs.
entries.de: Die Fähigkeit, Menschen dazu zu ermutigen, sich einzusetzen und auf gemeinsame Ziele hinzuarbeiten.

entries.ja: 組織全体の優先事項と長期的な方向性を踏まえて、取るべき行動を選ぶこと。
entries.ko: 조직의 전반적인 우선순위와 장기적인 방향을 염두에 두고 행동을 선택하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在选择行动时，考虑组织整体的优先事项和较长期的发展方向。
entries.es: Elegir acciones teniendo en cuenta las prioridades generales y el rumbo a más largo plazo de una organización.
entries.pt-BR: Escolher ações levando em conta as prioridades gerais e o rumo de uma organização a longo prazo.
entries.fr: Choisir des actions en tenant compte des priorités générales d’une organisation et de son orientation à plus long terme.
entries.de: Handlungen unter Berücksichtigung der übergeordneten Prioritäten und der längerfristigen Ausrichtung einer Organisation auswählen.

entries.ja: 判断を下す前に、情報、前提、推論の筋道を注意深く検討すること。
entries.ko: 판단을 내리기 전에 정보, 전제, 추론 과정을 주의 깊게 검토하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在作出判断之前，仔细审视信息、假设和推理过程。
entries.es: Examinar cuidadosamente la información, las suposiciones y los razonamientos antes de llegar a un juicio.
entries.pt-BR: Examinar cuidadosamente informações, suposições e raciocínios antes de formar um julgamento.
entries.fr: Examiner attentivement les informations, les présupposés et les raisonnements avant de porter un jugement.
entries.de: Informationen, Annahmen und Gedankengänge sorgfältig prüfen, bevor man zu einem Urteil gelangt.

entries.ja: 職業生活を通じて、より大きな責任を担うことや、より上位の職に就くことへ向けて成長していくこと。
entries.ko: 직업 생활 전반에 걸쳐 더 큰 책임을 맡거나 더 높은 직위에 오르는 방향으로 발전하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在职业生涯中，逐步发展到承担更大责任或担任更高层次的职位。
entries.es: El desarrollo a lo largo de la vida laboral hacia mayores responsabilidades o puestos de mayor nivel.
entries.pt-BR: O desenvolvimento ao longo da vida profissional em direção a responsabilidades maiores ou cargos mais avançados.
entries.fr: L’évolution au cours de la vie professionnelle vers davantage de responsabilités ou des postes de niveau supérieur.
entries.de: Die Entwicklung hin zu mehr Verantwortung oder höheren Positionen im Laufe des Berufslebens.

entries.ja: 特定の状況にある人々に求められる、最低限の出発点となる水準。
entries.ko: 특정 상황에 있는 사람들에게 출발점으로 요구되는 최소한의 기준.
entries.zh-Hans: 在特定情境下，人们应达到的最低初始标准。
entries.es: Un nivel mínimo de partida que se espera de las personas en una situación determinada.
entries.pt-BR: Um padrão mínimo inicial esperado das pessoas em uma determinada situação.
entries.fr: Un niveau minimal de départ attendu des personnes dans une situation donnée.
entries.de: Ein Mindeststandard, der von Menschen in einer bestimmten Situation als Ausgangsniveau erwartet wird.

entries.ja: 別の資質や資源と組み合わされ、両者が一緒に働くようになっている。
entries.ko: 다른 자질이나 자원과 결합되어 둘이 함께 작용하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 与另一种素质或资源相结合，使两者共同发挥作用。
entries.es: Combinado con otra cualidad o recurso de modo que ambos actúen juntos.
entries.pt-BR: Combinado com outra qualidade ou recurso, de modo que os dois atuem em conjunto.
entries.fr: Associé à une autre qualité ou ressource de façon à ce que les deux agissent ensemble.
entries.de: Mit einer anderen Eigenschaft oder Ressource verbunden, sodass beide zusammenwirken.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
